items: **Vaibhav Sooryavanshi:** youngest-ever India international debutant (15y99d), surpassing Sachin Tendulkar (16y205d); also youngest to score a T20I fifty (15y118d).
**Rohit Sharma:** first Indian men's ODI century at Lord's; oldest Indian international centurion (39y80d, surpassed Tendulkar's 38y327d).
**Anjum Chopra:** inducted into ICC Cricket Hall of Fame; first Indian woman to play 100 ODIs.
**Anil Menon:** first astronaut of Malayali origin, 8-month ISS mission via Soyuz MS-29.
